title: Execute alias-safe grouped Dynamic Scale32 candidate

fresh_attempt_namespace.execution_marker_creation_rule: Create atomically exactly once only after the complete pre-attempt artifact set and every bound hash pass verification.

implementation_objective: Implement an isolated candidate-specific runner by combining the Fresh-Reviewer-verified alias-safe post-W4 model construction with the previously frozen grouped Dynamic Scale32 activation policy; do not modify or import mutable state from consumed attempt directories.

model_and_weight_policy.source_alias_assertion: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter and storage immediately after pinned-model load
model_and_weight_policy.split_operation: Clone the complete embedding tensor into a detached non-trainable lm_head Parameter before W4 and set only the in-memory config tie_word_embeddings field false
model_and_weight_policy.w4_scope: exactly 168 transformer Linear weights plus the separated lm_head weight
model_and_weight_policy.embedding_preservation: original embedding Parameter object, storage pointer, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 bytes remain unchanged

dynamic_activation_policy.selection: preserve each frozen base Scale32 significand and select the minimum legal exponent delta in [-24,+24] that keeps the effective exponent in [-24,+4] and covers every finite group lane

pre_attempt_artifact_set.non_evaluator_inputs: the immutable four-prompt calibration contract plus Name one primary color in one lowercase word.; Return only the integer result of 9 multiplied by 7.; In five words, describe gentle rain.; Answer yes or no: Is water wet?
required_before_marker: hash-bound runner source and self-test result
candidate A and B construction manifests
dynamic quantizer self-test including legal-delta minimum, ties-to-even, all-zero, reserved -128, overflow fail-closed, and bound-hash mismatch rejection
fresh-candidate non-evaluator preflight with all 312 layer/event names, legal delta range, zero saturation, zero clipping, and no reserved -128 payload
predeclared contract binding every source, model, matrix, runner, tool-version, architecture, and policy hash
PREATTEMPT_READY.json that verifies all prior artifacts without creating execution_started.json

official_attempt_contract.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt_contract.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt_contract.evaluator_no_execution_rule: If execution_started.json exists but no candidate prompt completes, preserve the attempt, keep numerical correctness null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_failure_rule: If any candidate prompt completes but the binary gate is not met, set eligible=false, preserve exact disagreements, keep selected_policy_id null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_success_rule: If the 9/9 binary gate is met, seal immutable evidence and submit it to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or authorize downstream work before independent acceptance.

engineer_objective: Implement and self-test the fresh runner without modifying consumed artifacts; prove exact alias-safe candidate A/B construction; pass dynamic non-evaluator preflight without an attempt marker; then consume exactly one attempt-0001 over the unchanged nine-prompt matrix and submit immutable evidence to a Fresh Reviewer.
acceptance_check: A Fresh Reviewer independently verifies exact task and hash closure, source-tied then runtime-split lm_head behavior, preserved embedding bytes, legal dynamic Scale32 selection at all 312 boundaries, one consumed attempt, and 9/9 exact BF16 token-sequence plus response-gate agreement; selected_policy_id changes only after that adjudication.
prohibited_work: modify, reclaim, resume, rename, replay, complete, or reinterpret any consumed Option-B attempt
create the new execution marker during planning, runner development, or preflight
use any official nine-prompt input for calibration or preflight
modify RTL, testbenches, formal properties, synthesis constraints, certified PPA evidence, or the sealed two-token record
